name: File Manager Pro
author: KryonOS Team
description: Advanced dual-storage file manager for KryonOS & LilyGO T-Deck Plus. Features directory navigation, file copy/move across partitions, recursive deletion, atomic metadata inspection, text editor/viewer, hex chunk inspection, and audio/image previews.
changelog: Initial release of File Manager Pro featuring dual storage (Flash & SD), clipboard copy/move, recursive folder deletion, modal properties, text viewer, and hex chunk inspector.
